sentences.text: Catherine Tregenna is a Welsh playwright , television scriptwriter and actress .	Welsh	Wales

She wrote the play Art and Guff , co-wrote the series Cowbois ac Injans and four episodes of the BBC 's science fiction drama Torchwood : `` Out of Time '' , `` Captain Jack Harkness '' , `` Meat '' and `` Adam '' .	Cowbois ac Injans	Cowbois ac Injans	BBC	BBC	science fiction	science fiction	Torchwood	Torchwood	Out of Time	Out of Time (Torchwood)	Captain Jack Harkness	Captain Jack Harkness (Torchwood episode)	Meat	Meat (Torchwood)	Adam	Adam (Torchwood)
As well as co-writing Meat , she also created the meat props shown in the episode .	Meat	Meat (Torchwood)
`` Captain Jack Harkness '' was nominated for the 2008 Hugo Award for Best Dramatic Presentation , Short Form .	Captain Jack Harkness	Captain Jack Harkness (Torchwood episode)

She has also written episodes for EastEnders , Casualty , and for the first four series of ITV1 crime drama Law & Order : UK , which began transmitting in February 2009 .	EastEnders	EastEnders	Casualty	Casualty (TV series)	ITV1	ITV1
She played the character Kirsty McGurk , for several years , in Pobol Y Cwm and a doctor in Satellite City .	Pobol Y Cwm	Pobol Y Cwm	Satellite City	Satellite City (sitcom)

In November 2014 , it was confirmed that she would be writing an episode for the ninth series of Doctor Who , later confirmed to be titled `` The Woman Who Lived '' .	ninth series	Doctor Who (series 9)	Doctor Who	Doctor Who	The Woman Who Lived	The Woman Who Lived
